name: Xstate V5
headline: XState v5: Statechart Design & Implementation
short_description: This skill enables the integration of XState for managing complex state machines and statecharts. It's for developers looking to implement predictable state management in their applications.
author: statelyai

sections.overview:
This skill enables developers to design, implement, review, and migrate XState v5 statecharts in TypeScript applications. It provides support for modern v5 patterns, helping teams build predictable state machines and statecharts that keep code synchronized with visual diagrams. The skill is designed for developers working with complex state management who want to leverage XState's latest version for maintainable, readable state logic. It supports the full lifecycle of statechart development, from initial design through code review and migration from earlier XState versions.
Implementing complex state machines in applications.
Managing application states efficiently.
Creating interactive UIs with predictable behavior.
